job.description:
We are seeking a skilled Dialogflow Engineer to build and enhance our Property Management agent in Dialogflow, with the added requirement of integrating Twilio voice capabilities starting with a Proof of Concept (POC).

The successful candidate will work closely with our product and development teams to create and maintain a chatbot that can effectively handle a range of property management tasks, including maintenance requests, rent payments, and lease agreements.

Responsibilities:

Build and maintain a Property Management agent in Dialogflow, including developing and testing new intents, entities, and responses

Integrate Twilio voice capabilities to the chatbot, allowing users to interact with the chatbot via phone calls
Collaborate with product and development teams to identify areas for improvement and new features for the chatbot

Conduct testing and quality assurance on the chatbot to ensure accuracy and functionality

Work with customer support teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to the chatbot

Stay up-to-date on the latest trends and best practices in conversational design and development

Requirements:

Strong experience with Dialogflow, including building and maintaining complex agents

Demonstrated experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies

Solid understanding of chatbot development, including conversational design, intent mapping, and entity extraction

Proficient in at least one programming language such as Python, JavaScript, or Java

Experience with Twilio or other telephony platforms, including configuring and deploying phone numbers, building voice applications, and managing call flows

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Property Management or Real Estate industry
Experience with Dialogflow CX (Customer Experience) or Google Cloud Platform
Knowledge of RESTful API design and development
Experience with version control systems such as Git or SVN

POC Description:

As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to build a proof-of-concept (POC) for enhancing the Property Management agent in Dialogflow, with Twilio voice integration. The POC should include a set of new intents, entities, and responses that demonstrate the candidate’s ability to work with Dialogflow and Twilio, and develop high-quality chatbots with voice capabilities. The POC should also include a brief write-up of the development process and any challenges or solutions encountered. The POC will be evaluated by the hiring team for accuracy, functionality, and quality of design.
